Numerical IDs do not imply priority. Status does not advance automatically when a document or fixture specification is written. | Milestone requirements include their transitive hard prerequisites. Explicit integration/certification epics test connected behavior on compatible builds. An epic introducing another family must extend the applicable recipient-view, reconstruction, security and operational checks before admitting it. This never certifies a future family in advance; full-roster and release certification still cover their entire declared scope. | The selected presentation is low-resolution 3D pixel art inspired by David Holland. Camera/readability and art-production work have their own evidence gates; continuous planar/floor simulation remains authoritative. Reverify its Git root, task branch and pinned toolchain before execution. The supplied MultiplayerSessions Steam plugin has baseline compilation/widget checks; authoritative replication, connected sessions and provider capabilities remain unverified. Ticket planning does not establish implemented gameplay.
